findings: The exact rmcp-v3.1.4 crate declares http = version 1 and dev-dependency axum = version 0.8 for its Streamable HTTP tests.

The exact release test crates/rmcp/tests/test_subscriptions_streamable_http.rs constructs StreamableHttpService, nests it at /mcp, then wraps the router with axum::middleware::from_fn whose closure arguments are axum::extract::Request and axum::middleware::Next and which calls next.run(request).await. This source-qualifies an Axum middleware layer executing around the rmcp service before service dispatch.

Axum 0.8 documentation gives the authentication middleware form async fn auth(mut req: Request, next: Next), then req.extensions_mut().insert(current_user), then next.run(req).await. Therefore the precise candidate insertion form for a server-authenticated Principal is request.extensions_mut().insert(principal) before next.run(request).await.

The exact rmcp-v3.1.4 Streamable HTTP server source later injects inbound http::request::Parts into MCP request extensions with req.request.extensions_mut().insert(part). Because http::request::Parts carries its own Extensions map, a Principal inserted by the outer Axum middleware is preserved inside Parts.extensions for later handler-side extraction.

Cargo.lock is not present at the exact release commit, so this slice does not claim a specific Axum patch release beyond the declared compatible 0.8 series. The API form is nevertheless directly documented for Axum 0.8 and matches the exact release test's Request/Next middleware shape.
